outcome: Bilateral ulnar longitudinal deficiency with oligodactyly
Upper limb malformations (shortening of the left forearm and absence of three digits bilaterally)
Diagnosis of congenital longitudinal deficiency of the ulna
cohort: A full-term male newborn, born following an uncomplicated gestation with no abnormalities detected on prenatal ultrasounds.
finding: The primary finding was the detailed identification of upper limb malformations and the subsequent diagnosis of congenital longitudinal deficiency of the ulna in the newborn.
